integrity: Analytic parity and payoff proof plus standalone Python standard-library exact-rational verifier; no external data or unverifiable dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three alternatives, strict preferences, equally weighted voters.
Independent two-defender sampling with uniformly random within-candidate rank copies; not sampling distinct committees without replacement.
No assertion about larger candidate sets, other activation functions, manipulation, or equilibrium selection outside the stated thirteen-voter profile.
Prior Appendix A construction already implies qualitative Condorcet exclusion at eighteen voters; claimed contribution is the exact sharp thirteen-voter boundary and unique witness.
Potential unindexed equivalent small-electorate analysis remains a publication-priority risk; independent review has not been performed.
title: The thirteen-voter Condorcet exclusion threshold for stable \(2\)-lotteries
